about_the_game:
Features

  • 100% free. No DLC or microtransactions

  • Car customization. Style your car how you like it best (visual only)

  • Precise arcade controls. Master the paths and make turns with pixel-perfect accuracy

  • Tiny tracks. Each of the 15 maps can be completed in under a minute

  • Varied terrain. Jumps, boosts, water, grass, and road give each track its own feel

  • Ghosts. Race your previous time to see how you improve

Tips

Driftmania is meant to be a challenging game. Here's some tips to get you started:

  • Garage customizations do not change car handling. Make your car look however you want it to!

  • Take a good look at the minimap before starting a track. You need to anticipate the turns to get the best times

  • Grass does not slow you down. Cut corners as much as possible!

  • You turn faster when holding the D-Brake

  • Driving over yellow tiles will activate boost. Boost works with whatever direction you're facing - it doesn't matter where the arrow on the ground is pointing

  • You can jump over walls (and even drive on them!)

Credits

  • Created by Max Bize

  • Music by Vav

  • Cars (based on) art by PixelArtM

  • Cover art by TerracotaScarf

reviews:
“The presentation is great, the car graphics and turning are so smooth and there's some nice music between races. Where the game really shines is in the driving. The handling of the car is superb and the addition of a ghost mode makes hunting down faster times deeply satisfying”
Extar - Pico Playtime
short_description: Tiny tracks. Fast laps. Customize your car and get the best possible time across 15 challenging maps
